status: Review concept; no tip compatibility or manufacturing release

coordinates.y: positive towards rear beam; robot enters from negative Y

fit_rule.additional_requirement: Fork thickness plus vertical clearance must fit between tip rim and pipette/ejector sleeve; assess the complete swept tool envelope. Nominal tip volume is not a groove dimension.

illustrative_envelopes.status: Synthetic geometry checks, not measured articles or executable robot motion

hardware.fork_material: Metal insert candidate; material and edge finish to be selected after force and contamination tests
hardware.bin_material: Removable smooth-wall liner/bin candidate; prototype printing does not establish cleanability or leak tightness
hardware.frame_connections: Clearance holes and blind pilot placeholders only; threads, screws and welded/bolted joint design unqualified

workflow: Reserve collector workspace for one arm; confirm correct groove/article profile, bin seated and fill below qualified limit
Locate real tip collar and station datum; lower collar below fork underside while remaining above bin interior
Translate from negative Y into straight groove around the exposed shaft without dragging the tip rim sideways
Lift pipette vertically with qualified stroke, speed and force limit; tip rim bears against fork underside and tip drops into bin
Verify tip absent from pipette and cleared from fork; withdraw fully before releasing workspace reservation
Stop on jam, overload, missing bin, ambiguous detachment or stale observation; no blind retries
scope: Independent fixed station; arm source and its six rotary axes are unchanged
No pipette adapter, selected pipette model, robot inverse kinematics, live motion or SiLA server
Groove inserts are exchangeable in the mechanical concept; mounting holes alone do not define a qualified attachment
Static CAD and synthetic straight-line clearances do not establish full robot workspace, strength, aerosol containment or cleanability
One collector can be reserved by up to three arms sequentially; no simultaneous access
